personality: 1 (iOS-Native Clean) structure + 4 (Tactile) elements for Kiosk celebration
personality_one_liner: A high-trust, B2B healthcare lead engine that transforms into a premium, tactile game-show experience for the end user.

color_rules: Tier Colors STRICT MAP (Staff Dashboard): RED (Urgent/Top Tier) = bg-red-500, YELLOW (High Tier) = bg-amber-500, GREEN (Medium Tier) = bg-emerald-500, BLUE (Low Tier) = bg-blue-500, GREY (Unmatched) = bg-slate-300.
Unmatched GREY cards must look distinct-in-kind: flatten the shadow (shadow-none), set surface to transparent or muted (bg-slate-50), and use grey borders.
Kiosk strictly uses brand colors (Emerald) and celebratory tones; zero exposure of the Tier mapping colors in front of doctors.
web.layout: Control Room Grid for Admin (dense, tabular, high-signal data). Tablet/Kiosk uses massive centered layout with wide margins (max-w-2xl mx-auto) for standing interaction. Dashboard uses multi-column feed (masonry or row-based) highlighting the dual tier color bands prominently on the leading edge.
web.surface_microtheme: Crystal Glass for Kiosk UI overlays (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70); Grid Borders for Admin Console.
web.navigation_header: Staff/Admin: Solid background header with hard bottom border. Kiosk: NO navigation header (locked immersive mode), just a small subtle reset/admin logo in the corner.

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Wheel/Kiosk uses pure HTML/Tailwind and Canvas/Motion animations for the game experience.
components_strategy.interactive_logic: Admin and Dashboard use shadcn (Dialog, Table, Select, Switch) heavily customized for data density.
components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) and oversized (h-14, text-lg) for Kiosk. Standard rounded-md for Admin.

glassmorphism.recipe: backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 bg-white/70 + 1px inner stroke border-white/40

motion.hover_states: Dashboard cards lift on hover (-translate-y-1) with shadow-lg.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-through (opacity 0 to 1) for Kiosk form steps.
motion.buttons: Scale down on press (active:scale-95), transition-transform duration-200 ease-out.

web.data_testid: Every form field, table row action, and Wheel spin button MUST have a data-testid.

dos: Use on sticky bottom CTA in Kiosk/Form views
Use on bottom tab bar for Staff app
donts: Do not blur dense feed cards or live tracking stats

mobile.safe_area: All screens wrap in SafeAreaView. Bottom tab bar respects safe area.
mobile.touch_targets: >=64x64pt for iPad Kiosk inputs. >=44x44pt for Staff Mobile App.

screens.name: Admin Console
screens.purpose: Configure CSV mappings, scores, prize wheel rules, and Twilio alerts.

states.error: Red banner at top 'Failed to parse CSV' + Retry.

screens.layout: Bento grid logic: col-span-3 for main CSV staging, col-span-1 for side configuration forms (Thresholds/Wheel weights).

screens.name: Staff Dashboard
screens.purpose: Live auto-refreshing feed of captured leads allowing reps to spot high-value targets.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'No leads captured yet. Ensure kiosk is online.'

screens.layout: Row-based feed (mobile) or 2-3 column grid (web). Each card features TWO vertical color bands (Left border or top-right pill group) for 340B and RPM tiers. Grey cards intentionally flat/dimmed.

screens.name: Doctor Kiosk Form
screens.purpose: 3-screen landscape iPad form capturing doctor details rapidly.
screens.layout: Landscape locked. Single massive column. Huge text inputs and interest chips. Floating sticky bottom primary CTA in the thumb zone. Progress bar at top.

screens.name: Prize Wheel
screens.purpose: Full-screen celebratory edge-to-edge game triggered after form submission.

states.error: Silent fallback to static winning state if animation fails.

screens.layout: Immersive takeover. Wheel centered, huge SPIN button. Upon win, wheel transitions into a celebratory winning modal with redemption code.

medical_background.description: Subtle, clean background to be used behind the Kiosk Form screens at 20-30% opacity to prevent clinical starkness.

wheel_illustration.description: Visual reference or fallback for the prize wheel. The wheel UI should ideally be built in code/canvas, but this serves as a thematic backdrop or loading poster.

lead_empty_state.description: Use as a card-fill or illustration backing when the Staff Dashboard has zero leads captured.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL ABSTRACTION: The Doctor-facing Kiosk must NEVER display scoring logic, medicare data, or dollar amounts. It is purely a lead capture form followed by a fun prize wheel.

TIER BANDS: Implement the Staff Dashboard lead cards with TWO distinct color bands (340B tier, RPM tier) using the explicit colors: bg-red-500, bg-amber-500, bg-emerald-500, bg-blue-500, bg-slate-300.

GREY CARD DE-EMPHASIS: Grey (unmatched) lead cards must be distinct-in-kind. Strip their drop-shadow, give them a subtle bg-slate-50 background, and lower the opacity of non-essential text so high-value (Red/Yellow/Green) cards pop immediately.
KIOSK UI (IPAD): The Kiosk forms must use oversized tap targets (h-14 buttons, large chips) to accommodate standing users holding drinks. Do not use standard small web forms.

PRIZE WHEEL: Use canvas/HTML5 (e.g. canvas-confetti, react-custom-roulette) for the wheel and celebration. Ensure the winning spin replaces the wheel interface with a clear 'Copy Code'/'Redeem' state.
ADMIN CONSOLE: Use a data-dense, functional 'Control Room' grid for the CMS/CSV upload section. Maximize screen real estate.
